test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The mother loving looked / at her baby / as the nurse / brought her in.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **The mother loving looked**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace "**loving**" with "**lovingly**" to correct the sentence.
 
• Adding **-ly** to the verb makes it an adverb.
 
• An **adverb **is a word or phrase that modifies or qualifies an adjective, verb, or other adverb or a word group, expressing a relation of place, time, circumstance, manner, cause, degree, etc.
 
• **Lovingly **means with love or great care.
 
 
• **Example -** *They smile lovingly at each other.*
 
 
 
• Love is a noun, which means an intense feeling of deep affection.
 
• Loving is an adjective that means feeling or showing love or great care. It is used in continuous tenses.
 
• Adjectives describe or modify nouns and limit or restrict the meaning of nouns and pronouns.
 
• **The implied meaning of the sentence is:** As the nurse brought the infant in, the mother gave her a kind gaze.
 
• So, an adverb should be used here.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**

**Corrected sentence:** *The mother lovingly looked at her baby as the nurse brought her in.*
